# CEVA V3 public-safe research package

June 30, 2026 capital/share and discount anchor; October 19, 2026 information; retrospective conditional operating-value study

Final independent V3 review passed for bounded conditional admission; staging adapter and publication need separate approval. Current price targets, upside and historical backtests remain ineligible.

Read STUDY-v3.md or CEVA-v3.html. Exact reviewed V3 source inputs, outputs, forecast, history and sensitivities are retained. No original filing/PDF/transcript text is distributed. Primary facts and original analysis link to sources with hashes.

For reproducibility, run replay_dcf_v3.py in a copy of this folder (it rewrites generated outputs). Original-manifest-v3.json records the frozen source version including files not copied; packaging-manifest-v3.json is the local distribution inventory.
